description: This file defines a React functional component named PromptMessagesCard, which manages and displays a list of prompt messages with drag-and-drop reordering, editing, and removal functionalities. It uses various external UI component libraries such as @tremor/react, antd, and lucide-react, and handles message content and metadata updates.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Sets the index of the message being dragged to manage drag-and-drop reordering.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior and updates the index over which a dragged message is currently hovering.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Finalizes the drag-and-drop operation by calling onMoveMessage to reorder messages if indices differ.

methods.name: handleDragEnd
methods.description: Resets drag state variables after dragging completes.
